content: Alopa vayaꞌe neya vayaꞌefeꞌmo, ina kavaꞌmo hiyo, huka hapa paiyo, huno ha paiꞌniya gemae
Ani agufa hosu kavaꞌmo hugayaꞌmonanafa kagaemo lokiya gelefeꞌmo magoꞌe huka alika apaya malo.

Kosuna vayaꞌaifeꞌmo hapa paigeꞌapao hapauꞌniya kavateꞌmo alagepa huꞌa yagaiꞌa atege alagepa huꞌa yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya yahauve vayakana huꞌa maige apaipa apakesaleꞌmo alagepa huꞌa yagaiꞌa atege aigofeꞌmo osuꞌa lokiya vaiꞌa apakesa afiꞌa fatago huge hapau apayamopafiꞌmo hapauge atafauꞌa alagi huꞌa maige huꞌa maiyo.

Ani kava huka anekalo aꞌneꞌaifeꞌmo alika apaya malegeꞌapao aniꞌmo neꞌneꞌa negi gemo osuge hosu faigoko gemo osuge huteꞌa alagepa huꞌa yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya yahauve aꞌnegana huꞌa maiyo. Apakaemo alagepa gemo venemo aꞌne anagaꞌaifeꞌmo aliꞌa apaya malegeꞌapao
afiteꞌapaeꞌmo anauꞌapimogiꞌe mafaꞌneꞌapiꞌefeꞌmo hapau apayamopafiꞌmo hapaino.

Aliꞌa apaya malesageꞌa venemo aꞌnemogimo afiteꞌapaeꞌmo apaipa apakesaleꞌmo alagepa huꞌa yagaiꞌa atege yaveyave apaipa apakesa afige noꞌapifiꞌmo alagepa aliꞌya alige yuna apaipa kalige anauꞌapimogi apaiyafiꞌmo maige husageꞌapaeꞌmo muki vayaꞌmogi Goti geꞌaeꞌmo huꞌa faipa huꞌa oꞌategae.
Ani kava huka neya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, lapaipa lapakesaleꞌmo alagepa hutapa yagaita ateyo, huka apakesamo alika hapa paiyo.

Kagaemo muki kavaꞌalefeꞌmo vayaꞌmogi kakame hisaya agufa alagepa kavaꞌageꞌmo huvo. Alika apaya neꞌmalekaeꞌmo okasalisiya geletiꞌmo lokiyaꞌage geletiꞌmo Gotitefeꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌmo neꞌalika alika apaya malo.
Huꞌa faipa huꞌa oꞌatesayafeꞌmo alagepa lokiya gemo hapa paigeꞌapao kame vayakamogi lagaefeꞌmo hosu faigoko gemo osisageno apavagage hino.

Nofiteꞌmo maiꞌneꞌa aliꞌya neꞌaliya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, kava vekatapimo geꞌamo neꞌafitapa muki aliꞌyaꞌalefeꞌmo amuse hisiya agufa kavaꞌmo hiyo. Kava vekatapimo geꞌaleꞌmo aeta atagaina hutapa osuta maleꞌnisiya yapatiꞌmo mago yaꞌmo kumaya oꞌalitapa alagepa kavaꞌmo higenoꞌao kava vekatapimoꞌa, alagepa huꞌa aliꞌyaꞌmo neꞌaliya vayaꞌmo maiꞌnae, huno hino, huka hapa paiyo. Apakaemo muki ani kavaꞌmo hisaya kavatetiꞌmo Gotiꞌa lagufamo alino katino nelateya vekamo geꞌaleꞌmo aliꞌa asaga huꞌa atesayafeꞌmae.
Alagepa kavaꞌmo nehutapa Kalaisifeꞌmo agava maiyo, huno huꞌniya gemae
Gotiꞌa fiku hapa maeno apamitenoꞌaeꞌmo vayaꞌai apakufamo alino katino neꞌapateya kavaꞌamo muki vayaꞌmo ago alino afole aino apave liꞌniye.

Gotiꞌa ani kavaꞌaletiꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, mono nosaya kavatapimogi ma mopafi kavafeꞌmo lapaꞌye nehiya kavatapimogi hutapa alita ataletetapa hemenimo maiꞌnetapaeꞌmo lapauꞌniya kavateꞌmo yagaige vayaꞌaitegamo fatago kavaꞌmo huge Gotifekeꞌmo mono huge hutapa maiyo, huno alino laya neꞌmale.
Ani kavaꞌmo nehutaeꞌmo ala vekamo Gotitimoꞌa lagufamo alino katino nelateya vekamo Yesu Kalaisi ha le konali yaꞌamo afole aisiyafeꞌmo lamogaga aita agava neꞌmaune.

Agaemo muki hosu kavaꞌmo nehuna kavategatiꞌmo miya faino hatu maeno latetenoꞌaeꞌmo hosu kavatimo aeno kalo paeno lateꞌnigeta agaiꞌa vayaꞌamo maiꞌneta layamukiki huta alagepa kavaꞌmo huta maisunafeꞌmo agaiꞌa agufaꞌamo ofalinigana huno alino Gotiꞌmo amiꞌniye.

Ani kavatefeꞌmo alika apaya neꞌmalekaeꞌmo himamukaletiꞌmo alagepa kavaꞌmo hisayafeꞌmo apakesamo alige hosu kavaꞌmo osisayafeꞌmo hosu kavaꞌmo nehae, huka huge huka hapa paiyo. Mago vayaꞌmo apateꞌnegeꞌa afa neꞌmo maiꞌnane, huꞌa osiyo.
